data.description:
Write RED test cases for the sentinel lockout behavior before implementation in read-config.sh.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE (adding new test functions to existing test file that FAIL before Task 2)

## File to Update
tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh

## New Test Functions (must FAIL against unmodified read-config.sh before Task 2 implementation)
1. test_read_config_sentinel_rejects_merge_strategy
   - Given: .claude/dso-config.conf with merge.strategy=pr AND .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated sentinel exists
   - When: bash read-config.sh merge.strategy
   - Then: exits non-zero (exit 1)

2. test_read_config_sentinel_rejects_enforcement_strategy
   - Given: .claude/dso-config.conf with enforcement.strategy=ci AND .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated sentinel exists
   - When: bash read-config.sh enforcement.strategy
   - Then: exits non-zero

3. test_read_config_sentinel_rejection_emits_recovery_message
   - Given: sentinel exists, any legacy key read
   - When: bash read-config.sh merge.strategy 2>&1
   - Then: stderr contains "git checkout HEAD" (recovery command hint)

4. test_read_config_sentinel_dso_workflow_unaffected
   - Given: .claude/dso-config.conf with dso.workflow=ci-pr AND sentinel exists
   - When: bash read-config.sh dso.workflow
   - Then: exits 0 and prints "ci-pr" (dso.workflow reads are never blocked)

5. test_read_config_no_sentinel_legacy_key_allowed
   - Given: .claude/dso-config.conf with merge.strategy=pr AND no sentinel file
   - When: bash read-config.sh merge.strategy
   - Then: exits 0 and prints "pr" (pre-migration: legacy keys still work)

## Notes
- Tests must create a temp repo with git init so git rev-parse --show-toplevel works
- Sentinel file is at: <git-root>/.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated
- Follow suite runner guard: tests only run when script is executed directly (not sourced)

## .test-index
- Add RED marker for read-config.sh: [test_read_config_sentinel_rejects_merge_strategy] for plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_read_config_sentinel_rejects_merge_strategy\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 5 test functions exist in tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh
- [ ] All 5 test functions FAIL when run against unmodified read-config.sh (RED confirmed)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-read-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -E 'FAIL|PASS' | grep -c FAIL | grep -qv '^0$'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_read_config_sentinel_rejects_merge_strategy\]' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: RED/UPDATE: test-read-config.sh — sentinel lockout and dso.workflow unaffected tests
